title: The jade forest pool
alt: An intricate jade forest surrounds a shallow pool and a small frog on a dark wooden plinth.
description: A complete openwork sculpture explores translucent stone, connected botanical forms and precise miniature detail.
prompt: A magnificent complete carved jade sculpture of a tropical forest on a dark walnut plinth. Broad leaves, arching roots, curling fern fronds and a shallow pool form one continuous translucent pale-green stone landscape. One small jade frog sits naturally on a low rock at the edge of the pool, with a coherent head, body and four attached limbs. Every openwork leaf connects to a branch or stem. Fine carved detail, luminous thin jade edges, refined museum object photography, the whole sculpture and plinth visible, no writing.
